newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's HBL Modaraba rises 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's HBL Modaraba rises 15 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Habib Bank Ltd Modaraba, a mutual fund, 10-rupee stock rose 0.75 rupee, or 15 percent, to 5.75 on Tuesday's settlement day on speculative buying before Friday's 1997/98 (July-June) budget, dealers said.
Modarabas, or Islamic mutual funds, have been depressed for much of the past three years, but a dealer at Fortune Securities said the scrips had recently showed signs of recovery.
Some 2,000 Habib Bank Ltd Modaraba shares changed hands in early trade.
